description: This file defines an interface MapperLimitsConfig which provides configuration settings for the behavior of a message mapper component in the Connectivity service. It includes method signatures for retrieving various maximum counts related to source and target mappers and messages, as well as an enumeration for the default configuration values and their associated paths.

classes.name: MapperLimitsConfig
classes.description: An interface that specifies configuration settings related to mapper limits in the Connectivity service.

classes.name: MapperLimitsConfig.MapperLimitsConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration implementing KnownConfigValue that defines known configuration path expressions and their default values for MapperLimitsConfig.

methods.name: getMaxSourceMappers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of mappers that can be defined in one source.

methods.name: getMaxMappedInboundMessages
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of inbound messages that can be invoked by one mapper in the source.

methods.name: getMaxTargetMappers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of mappers that can be defined in one target.

methods.name: getMaxMappedOutboundMessages
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of outbound messages that can be invoked by one mapper in the target.
